description: Grade a domain A-F for cold email readiness. Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, blacklists and domain age together and returns a weighted score with a per-check breakdown and what to fix. Start here for open-ended "is this domain any good" questions. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

domain.description: Domain to grade, e.g. "acme.com". Not an email address.

name: check_deliverability

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.
